newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index little changed in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index little changed in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange closed on Friday almost unchanged in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 597.23 from 597.41 on Thursday.
Trade volume was two million dinars against one million dinars.
Coca-Cola bottler SFBT continued on its downward trend, easing 3.56 dinars to 115.14 dinars. STB bank was down 0.64 dinar to 20.6 dinar with 21,021 shares changing hands.
Banque de l'Habitat was up 1.02 dinar to 35.07 dinars. Banque Nationale Agricole gained 0.92 dinar to 31.86 dinars.
